# FED Mining Solutions & Parts

> OEM-compatible hydraulic drifter spare parts for Sandvik and Epiroc rock drills. Based in Turkey. Worldwide shipping.

FED Mining Solutions & Parts is a Turkey-based manufacturer and exporter of hydraulic rock drill (drifter) spare parts. We supply OEM-compatible replacement parts for Sandvik and Epiroc / Atlas Copco drifter models used in underground and surface mining operations.

## What We Sell

We supply 186+ spare parts across 8 categories:

- **Pistons** – For Sandvik HL and Epiroc COP series drifters
- **Seal Kits** – 400h and 800h maintenance kits
- **Bushings** – Guide bushings and chuck bushings
- **Valve Assemblies** – Distributor valve assemblies
- **Accumulators** – HP and LP type
- **Shank Adapters** – T38, T45, T51 thread types
- **Gears & Shafts** – Rotation gear sets
- **Hardware** – Tension bars, bolts, fasteners

All parts are manufactured from induction-hardened alloy steel to original OEM specifications.

## Compatible Drifter Models

### Sandvik / Tamrock Drifters
- HL500 – Underground light drifter (145 kg)
- HL700 – Underground drifter, DT821 / DD series rigs (185 kg)
- HL1000 – Underground heavy drifter, DD422i / DT1131i (240 kg)
- HLX5 – Surface drifter, Pantera / Leopard DI (260 kg)
- RD314 – Surface light rig drifter (142 kg)
- RD520 – Surface drifter
- RD525 – Surface drifter, Ranger / Pantera DP (195 kg)

### Epiroc / Atlas Copco Drifters
- COP1638 – Underground Boomer M2 / L2D (160 kg)
- COP1838 – Underground Boomer / ROC D7 (175 kg)
- COP2560 – Underground Boomer XL / L2D (270 kg)
- COP3060 – Large surface rig drifter (295 kg)
- COP4050 – Surface ROC D7-11 series (380 kg)
- MD20 – Surface ROC series (210 kg)

## Service Offering

- Individual spare parts for all listed drifter models
- Complete 400-hour overhaul kits (pre-packaged for scheduled maintenance)
- Complete 800-hour overhaul kits
- Drifter rebuild consultation
- Machine hour tracking portal for registered customers (400h maintenance reminders)
- OEM-cross reference lookup (find parts by OEM number)

## Warranty

400-hour overhaul warranty on all parts and rebuild units.
